## Checklist

- [ ] If a page was added or renamed, `SUMMARY.md` is updated (pages not listed there don't appear in GitBook)

- [ ] Code examples are provided in both TypeScript and Python where applicable
- [ ] No contract addresses duplicated inline — pages link to `developers/networks.md`
- [ ] `docs/changelog.md` past entries are untouched (append-only)
- [ ] No secrets, real API keys, or internal URLs in the diff
